nav_header_v6.DESCRIPTION: Apollo Nav v6 â€” Luxury Minimalist Header. Source of truth: _library/_dev working/_current/header.html
nav_header_v6.STATUS: DOCUMENTED â€” 13 PHP template part comment blocks embedded in header.html
nav_header_v6.php_conversion_notes: header.html contains extreme inline PHP conversion comments. Any dev can convert to template parts without prior Apollo knowledge.
nav_header_v6.load_order: data.php MUST be first script after <body> â€” engine.php depends on window.ApolloNavData

template_parts.content: <head> contents: meta, CDN core.js (wp_enqueue_script blocking fetchpriority=high), CORS shield inline, CSS (extract to nav-v6.css)
div#aprio-overlay + div.aprio-header-blur â€” zero PHP vars, static. JS controls via .on class.
Inline <script> motor JS dev-verbose: Panel, DM (KEY=apollo-dark-mode), Clock, BurgerArrow, Nav, Renderer, Morphism, NavFX, LazyList, boot()
template_parts.CRITICAL: Use nav-engine.php in SCRIPT_DEBUG mode, engine.php in production. NEVER both simultaneously.

template_parts.content: <nav#pn-nav> burger slide-in panel. #nav-list is EMPTY in PHP â€” JS injectAsideToBurger() clones from <aside> on open. DO NOT populate server-side.
div#pn-act â€” messages (#msg-list) + notifications (#notif-list). Both empty in PHP, populated by LazyList JS from ApolloNavData.
div#pn-apps bento grid. #bento-apps empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderApps() from ApolloNavData.APPS[].
div#pn-pf user profile panel. #pf-hero + #pf-menu empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderProfile() from ApolloNavData.PROFILE.
<header.tb> full top bar. Dynamic: avatar URL, unread badge .dot.on, clock #agoraH (live via JS Clock).
apollo_functions_needed: apollo_has_unread_activity(int $user_id): bool â€” query apollo_notifications table

template_parts.content: <aside.da> SOURCE OF TRUTH for sidebar nav. JS injectAsideToBurger() clones its <li> items to burger panel. Populate from WP nav menu registered as 'apollo-sidebar'.
template_parts.current_class: .ni.on â€” can be pre-set server-side for active page
template_parts.nav_anchor_class: .na â€” MANDATORY on every <a>, JS event delegates on this class

template_parts.content: <main#main-content> + div.cg#cards-grid. Cards grid empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderCards() from ApolloNavData.CARDS[].
MOST CRITICAL part. Defines window.ApolloNavData={APPS,PROFILE,CARDS,MESSAGES,NOTIFICATIONS}. MUST be first script in <body>. All arrays built server-side via apply_filters.
template_parts.SECURITY: ALWAYS wp_json_encode() â€” NEVER raw json_encode(). Sanitize all values before including in array.

template_parts.content: Production-minified boot engine. Same modules as nav-engine.php but compact. Use: SCRIPT_DEBUG=false â†’ engine.php, SCRIPT_DEBUG=true â†’ nav-engine.php. NEVER both simultaneously.
Lazy-load patch: hydrates #msg-list and #notif-list, injects NavFX wave picker. Uses MutationObserver with disconnect() after success. Can use defer.
template_parts.future: Replace ApolloNavData.MESSAGES with REST fetch to apollo/v1/chat/threads using X-WP-Nonce header

template_parts.content: GSAP bundle (async, fetchpriority=high) + morphism.js (defer). Must enqueue via wp_enqueue_script â€” NOT inline â€” to prevent duplication across plugins.

js_data_contract.PROFILE: Object|null â€” {name, role, avatar, menu[]}. null when logged out.
js_data_contract.CARDS: Array â€” {id, title, body, tag, pri:bool}
js_data_contract.MESSAGES: Array â€” {unread:bool, avatar, name, text, time}. Consumed in batches of 10 by LazyList.
js_data_contract.NOTIFICATIONS: Array â€” {type:'alert'|'highlight'|'info', isNew:bool, icon, iconColor, text, cta, time}. Batches of 10.

js_modules_map.DM: Dark mode. KEY must be 'apollo-dark-mode'. Syncs with script.js DM_KEY.
js_modules_map.Panel: Master panel manager for all .pn elements + overlay #ov.
js_modules_map.injectAsideToBurger: Clones <aside> li items into #nav-list with animation classes.
js_modules_map.Nav: Marks .ni.on on anchor click, closes panel on mobile.
js_modules_map.Renderer: renderApps(), renderProfile(), renderCards() â€” all from ApolloNavData.
js_modules_map.Morphism: Lazy init of window.ApolloMorphism SVG icon system, retries 12Ã—.
js_modules_map.NavFX: _observer stored in NavFX._observer, disconnected on beforeunload.
js_modules_map.LazyList: Infinite scroll for msgs and notifs. Ghost card triggers load-more.
js_modules_map.boot: DOMContentLoaded entry point. Calls all .init() methods.

nav_header_v6.FORBIDDEN_dark_mode_key: apollo-dm â€” DO NOT USE. Diverges from script.js DM_KEY='apollo-dark-mode'.
nav_header_v6.icon_system: icon.v1.0.3.min.js â€” translates ri-* classes to inline SVG. DO NOT load remixicon.css alongside â€” causes icon duplication (font glyph + SVG rendered simultaneously).
nav_header_v6.FORBIDDEN_remixicon_css: NEVER load remixicon@4.x CSS font when icon.js is active. Root cause of icon duplication bug.
nav_header_v6.cors_shield: Use capture-phase addEventListener('error') for resource load failures only. NEVER window.onerror with broad apollo.rio.br domain suppression â€” hides real JS bugs.
nav_header_v6.script_src_inline_rule: A <script> tag with src= attribute IGNORES all inline content per HTML spec. Nav engine MUST be pure inline <script> without src=.
nav_header_v6.observer_rule: ALL MutationObserver instances MUST store reference and call .disconnect() on beforeunload with {once:true}.
